fact: The PARP 3 programme (Enabel, DCAF, Coginta), aligned to the 2024-2029 government action plan presented in June 2024, lists support to extending the FCICAP criminal file to Kinshasa and three provinces (Equateur, Ituri, Kasai).
title: Programme d'appui à la réforme de la police en RDC (PARP 3)
